home.heroTitle: Build your future with Geant Electronics
home.heroDescription: Join a leading Algerian electronics and home appliances company. We are hiring talent ready to scale innovation.
home.heroSecondary: 2500 employees, 10 African countries, and a European expansion vision.
home.trustDescription: Real industrial projects, growth opportunities, and a performance-driven culture.
home.innovationText: Deliver ambitious projects with modern tooling, strong engineering standards, and room to experiment.
home.growthText: Contribute to expansion across Africa and beyond with teams that execute fast and learn continuously.
home.valuesText: Work with a culture grounded in accountability, respect, and long-term career development.
home.featuredDescription: Open positions available now. Choose a role to view full details and apply.
home.processStep1Text: Submit your profile and CV in minutes.
home.processStep2Text: HR and business teams review your profile.
home.processStep3Text: Receive quick updates with transparent status tracking.
home.testimonialsDescription: A few words from colleagues across our key departments.
home.testimonial1Quote: The projects are concrete and the impact is immediate. You feel ownership from day one.
home.testimonial2Quote: The recruitment process is structured, fast, and respectful. Communication is clear at every step.
home.testimonial3Quote: Strong cross-team collaboration and a culture that values quality. It’s a great place to grow.
home.ctaDescription: Explore opportunities across our strategic teams: HR, IT, QHSE, Finance, Supply Chain, and After-Sales.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: An Algerian industrial leader with strong expansion momentum.
about.content: Géant Electronics, founded in 2005 by the Mebarkia brothers, is an Algerian leader in electronics and home appliances, employing 2500 people. Present in 10 African countries, it aims to expand into Europe, with innovation at its core.
about.missionBody: Design reliable and accessible products while developing operational excellence and local talent.
about.visionBody: Become a leading African and Euro-Mediterranean benchmark through quality, innovation, and customer proximity.
about.footprintBody: An industrial and commercial network active across 10 African countries with continuous expansion momentum.
